result.reason: The revision appropriately reduces the non-renewal notice period to 30 days and adds the preferred 60-day Vendor reminder while preserving the 12-month renewal term and either-party termination right. However, it does not cap renewal price increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%, or even at the fallback maximum of 5%; merely requiring notice of a proposed increase is insufficient. The drafting is otherwise clear and appropriately limited.
